      "observations": [
        "All 168 lines of the new test and its manifest registration were read. Two named sequential tasks use a shared helper for EWS and Graph. Each creates one remote folder/message, waits for discovery, marks the folder Offline, registers target-folder waiting state, drives mail-startup-done and mail:appIdle, then awaits its AutoSync listener.",
        "The two direct assertions check one total folder message and the Offline bit on the retrieved header. Both messages are nonempty and state expected behavior with should. The test does not compare downloaded body bytes or directly assert other folders, multiple download groups, offline-fetch errors, retry exhaustion or protocol wire equivalence.",
        "The accepted test file retains the owned implementation. The listener resolves only through onDownloadCompleted after its watched list empties; onDownloadError only logs and has no rejection path. The native manager sends a successful group notification before later pending-count handling, so the listener alone is not a universal all-groups-drained guarantee. Its one-message test case and subsequent assertions bound that observation.",
        "Review asks to use # rather than _ for private members and claims xpcshell teardown is unnecessary. The source has #promiseOnDownloadCompleted but still assigns _resolveOnDownloadCompleted. It retains account cleanup hooks, while this test does not remove its two manager listeners; AddListener/RemoveListener source confirms separate operations. No failure or lifetime leak outside this harness was reproduced, and the review claim does not change deliberate cleanup guidance.",
        "A concrete new JSDoc mismatch persists: runAutoSyncTest documents nsIMsgIncomingFolder and calls the argument an incoming message, but its task callers pass servers returned by the EWS/Graph factories. The inspected LocalAccountUtils chain reaches createIncomingServer, whose actual IDL returns nsIMsgIncomingServer. This is an argument-documentation finding, not a runtime type failure.",
        "onDownloadCompleted nests its whole useful branch under the folder-instance check, then performs list removal and completion checks. An early invalid-folder return is a local readability suggestion that can preserve this ordering; no unrelated helper cleanup or global nesting rule is inferred. Existing Graph offline-download/completion evidence is reused at exact accepted scope.",
        "The required primary is the complete Root composite a693bd369ee32070b4cc13de3575e568ab4f272cba21f2252b3910241d322eef. Its normal timeline and official XML identify the omitted DOM comment 2 as Eleanor's duplicate event, with every human body covered; there is no remaining missing-comment gap. Original collector scopes, times and hashes are reused.",
        "The two actual review threads request # private members and question teardown. The source adopts #promiseOnDownloadCompleted while retaining _resolveOnDownloadCompleted; account cleanup remains, and listener removal is not added. This source outcome does not turn the teardown remark into a general cleanup rule. The two direct assertions remain bounded to message count and the header Offline flag."
